prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [choose_path, reorder] Story Overview Before Path Decision Reorder: Reorders the story overview to lead the onboarding journey, giving context on desktop pet capabilities prior to asking users to select a path. (why: Users take a long mean time on choose_path (514s), indicating hesitation without understanding companion options upfront.)
1: [home, wait_info] Desktop Overlay Test & Asset Load Checklist: Adds a desktop render compatibility checklist to the waiting screen to verify overlay permissions while companion assets generate. (why: 3 support tickets reported pets failing to appear on desktop or app launching issues, and the waiting step has high mean duration (2336s).)
2: [adoption, layout] Compact Multi-Angle Photo Uploader Grid: Updates the photo upload screen to a grid layout with explicit visual target cards for front, side, and angle photos. (why: Custom pet generation failed or produced visual bugs for 3 support users, contributing to adoption friction.)
3: [finish, hint] Taskbar Pinning & Tray Docking Launch Hint: Displays an interactive hint demonstrating how to find pet controls in the system tray and pin the app shortcut upon finishing onboarding. (why: Multiple users contact support after onboarding confused about how to hide or summon their companion once onboarding closes.)
4: [choose_path, layout] Split Interactive Path Selector Layout: Transforms the path selection screen into a side-by-side split card layout comparing Instant Pet Adoption vs Custom Pet Creation. (why: Mean time spent on choose_path is 514s, indicating users struggle to compare benefits between pre-made and custom companion paths.)
5: [sign_in, copy] Account Persistence & Multi-Device Sync Reassurance Copy: Rewrites the sign-in screen headline and body copy to stress that signing in locks pet customization to the account and guards against data resets. (why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or resetting after signing in, pointing to confusion and anxiety around account state persistence.)
6: [home, notification] Background Pet Ready Audio Prompt & Alert: Enables audio feedback and desktop notification triggers when waiting screen generation completes so users can safely switch windows. (why: Home target step has high mean waiting time (2336s), showing users walk away or tab out while pet generation finishes.)

scores.note: Reordering story overview addresses high choice duration (514s) but lacks support ticket backing.
Addresses support tickets about pet render failures during long wait times at home step.
Targets adoption step which has the highest dropoff (28.9%) and 3 support tickets about upload bugs.
Finish step loses 26.2% of users; tray hint fixes high support confusion after onboarding.
Split layout simplifies path evaluation to reduce high choose_path duration.
Cheap copy-only update supported by 8 support complaints regarding account persistence.
Audio/notification alerts help recover tabbed-out users during extreme home waiting time (2336s).
